title: *LIVE ALERT* Stream Zeteo UK’s London Launch Event With Mehdi and Zack Polanski
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
You've seen **Zeteo** events on your screen before, but you've never seen them
livestreamed… until now. We are launching **Zeteo UK** this **Monday**
,**September 14**, from London's Barbican Centre at **2:15pm EDT** (**7:15pm
BST** / **11:15am PDT**), and we're bringing the party to you at home. (The
event itself is sold out! More than 1,000 audience members are expected!)

If you're a _paid_ subscriber _,_ you will get to [watch live
conversations](https://open.substack.com/live-stream/358263?utm_source=post-
publish) on stage between **Mehdi** and **Zeteo UK** journalists and
contributors **Shehab Khan, Sangita Myska,** and **Peter Oborne,** as well as
Green Party leader **Zack Polanski**.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

We only got here because of your support, and we want you to be part of it
every step of the way. Add our livestream to your calendar and watch the
launch at [Zeteo.com](http://zeteo.com) or [Zeteo.UK](http://zeteo.uk) by
[clicking here](https://open.substack.com/live-stream/358263?utm_source=post-
publish).

If you're a free subscriber, [upgrade to a paid
subscription](https://zeteo.com/subscribe) to access the livestream and watch
the launch live!

london?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&action=share)
